cases.long_description:
Long Description of Sighting Report
Two orbs or UAP's Sighting Monday January 27th, 2025 at 7.48 pm.
I was looking to the night sky as I do often while out walking the dog. I caught a brief flickering from (2) stars at a glance, then what happened next defined logic. Two stars, one positioned North at 12 o'clock north, then another star positioned South at 6 o'clock south measuring what looked like 4' apart from each other from my view point. I believed them to be stars in the sky until they moved counterclockwise 45 degrees in unison like they were connected to each other as one body. They were in perfect sync & changed position from the 12 - 6 o'clock , to 9 - 3o'clock. They split off separately in opposite directions quickly. From the 1st second of filming, 1 to 23 seconds I kept panning from left to right briefly to get my phone back to the right a little bit to try to get them both in the same view but the 2nd orb / UAP accelerated quickly and was out of my line of view within the camera frame. The 1st one minute into filming I stopped trying to locate the 2nd orb & focused instead, which began movement at 12 o'clock after both had done that counter clock rotation. I can be heard saying, well it's gone from two orbs to now, only one. The one orb that I was still following went from moving, kick moving and going up and down and took a left and to the right I tried to keep the camera as still as I could. It seemed to kind of fade in and out flash kind of blue and white and then vanished behind the tree line.
cases.location: Two flickering stars (renamed Orb's) positioned N & S of each other suddenly rotated counterclockwise 45

cases.long_description:
Long Description of Sighting Report
I took three really good pictures of it as it passed overhead.
At first, I thought it was a helicopter only it didn't make a sound. When it came out from behind the trees, I knew exactly what I was looking at. I pulled out my phone and took the pictures with two additional magnifications. It was moving about 10 mph maybe less. I guess it was about 100-200 ft above me and approximately 4-6 ft in diameter.
How do I monetize these pictures? One of the things I'm most proud of is that the star-field in the pictures is not blurred.

Long Description of Sighting Report
Observed possible drone like the new jersey events. Disregarded because I felt I'd been taking too many videos etc. Drove away from house Observed the blinking pattern that I felt I should record to compare speed and pattern of lights flashing. Pulled out phone to record and Observed orb type light moving sporadically around my field of vision towards drone. Only visible on camera. Put windows up down etc. Could not recreate upon returning to location on multiple occasions. Only visible on camera. The Observed drone disappeared 50 seconds upon recording.
cases.location: Observed possible drone began recording Observed orb type object only visible on camera

cases.long_description:
Long Description of Sighting Report
I finally captured a glowing, flying, hovering object that I'm almost certain is the one I have seen multiple times while I was driving, over the past 2 months. It's in the same wooded area when I see it flying. It's also visible from my street. In this video, I was filming an "orb" type object in the sky in the other direction and happened to turn around and point my camera in the opposite direction, I saw it and kept recording! The craft was quiet, and the whole thing looks lit up a goldish, white color. When I see it from my car, it looks like it has wings. it's huge compared to other "NJ mystery drones" I believe I've seen in my area for 2 months. When I see this while driving, it swoops, turns around, goes a little higher above the tree line, then closer to it. I have another video of what I believe to be the this, from my car this week. Get in touch if you want to see that as well. This one was an approved sighting by Enigma Labs, so I definitely want your opinion! Please let me know what you find! Thank you!
cases.location: I saw a glowing object flying near trees near my development.

cases.long_description:
Long Description of Sighting Report
I was standing in my driveway taking my dog out to answer the call of nature, when I spotted bright white lights in the distance. I live on the top of a mountain for context, and there is a ridge between my mountain, and the surrounding mountains in the distance. I observed the craft initially from a distance of ca. 1/4 mi. away, and it was bearing E to W towards my house. As the craft got closer, I realized that the lights were not a typical aircraft pattern. As it came close towards my house (W of its location) it became obvious that this was not a standard aircraft of any kind I know. The craft came within 100 ft of my house, and was dead silent. It was moving perhaps at 10 mph (too slow for normal aircraft to not fall out of the sky). When the craft was right beside my house you could clearly see that it was disc-shaped (or what one would call a conventional saucer). The dome was clearly visible on top, though it also had a dome of sorts on the underside, also clearly visible. Both the upper and lower domes appeared to be the same size (they craft was symmetrical in shape). The craft had a consistent blinking, white light pattern, that moved counter-clockwise along the edge of the craft. I could not discern the color of the craft, as it's pitch dark at night where I live, but the lights on the craft illuminated it that the shape & size was clearly visible. The craft continued moving E to W until ii disappeared behind the mountains on the other side of me.

Roughly 15 minutes later, as I was inside watching TV, I saw light out of the large sliding glass door window in my living room, so I stepped back outside. When I walked out to my front driveway, I could see the craft again, and it was hovering maybe 20 feet above the road that runs behind my house, then slowly moved off down that road at perhaps 15-20 mph until I fly out of my line of sight. In the second instance, the craft looked identical to how it appeared the first instance 15 minutes prior. The shape, light pattern, complete lack of noise, etc. were all the same, so I assume it was the same craft again.

The first sighting really had my heart beating quickly. The second sighting, I was in disbelief, my heart was racing, and my knees and hands were shaking. I couldn't believe what I had just witnessed, not once, but twice. Thei first time I kept telling myself I wasn't crazy, and I knew what I saw, but the second sighting 15 minutes later, I knew there was no shadow of a doubt in my mind. I don't know what they craft was, but I know what I saw. I was in such shock that taking my phone out to try to capture a video or picture didn't even cross my mind, but if I see it again, I'll be prepared. Unbelievable sighting.
cases.location: Large saucer-shaped UFO spotted from my driveway (on the top of a mountain). Craft had E to W bearing, then disappeared over the ridge. Ctd

cases.long_description:
Long Description of Sighting Report
Looked like a blinking star. When I zoomed at 5x I could see a triangular shape with flashing lights.

Long Description of Sighting Report
I was walking my dog at my apartment complex and noticed a very bright orb high in the sky. This orb was brighter and much larger than any stars or planes in the sky. The sky was completely clear, no cloud cover. The orb was pulsating and not perfectly circular. I witnessed the orb move westward across the sky and then straight up. It then stopped and a much smaller, dim orb came from the bottom of the large bright orb. It descended then moved west across the sky climbing in altitude as it went. The smaller orb was much smaller and dimmer than anything in the sky to the point it was hard to track and lost sight of it within a minute and a half or so. The large orb stayed stationary after this while I was in the fenced dog park in the middle of our complex for about 20 minutes. I kept watching the orb and did not notice any major movements for the remainder of the sighting. I went back outside to the dog park area around 11:30 p.m. the same evening and the orb was completely gone, and in that patch of the sky there were no visible stars it was just black.

I have witnessed two other UAP sightings at this same dog park over the last few months. One was a large triangular craft that slowly flew overhead and then climbed very high in altitude before flying off. The second was what looked like a drone but was completely silent and extremely high in the sky. This object made many dramatic maneuvers and a lot of movement for several minutes. Both of these sightings I have recordings of from my iPhone 16 pro max.
cases.location: Bright white orb in the sky, moved west then straight up and ejected a much smaller, more dim orb that seemed to drop form the orb then move west
